header:
What things cost in
**Costco hot dogs**

vo.text: A month of Netflix? **≈ 12 hot dogs.**
That's a hot dog a day for **730 years.**

verdict.text:
A hot dog a day
for **≈ 730 years.**

notes: Unit: Costco hot dog + soda combo, $1.50 (unchanged since 1985). Maths: $17.99 ÷ $1.50 = 11.99 (Netflix Standard, US, 2025-26); $799 ÷ $1.50 = 532.67 (iPhone 17 US launch price, Sept 2025); $1,700 × 12 = $20,400, ÷ $1.50 = 13,600; $50,000 ÷ $1.50 = 33,333.3 (average new-car transaction price ≈ $50,000, KBB 2025); $400,000 ÷ $1.50 = 266,666.7 (a typical US home, median existing-home price ≈ $400-420K in 2025). Verdict: 266,667 ÷ 365 = 730.6 years of one hot dog a day (≈ 730).
